notes.title: Support for Windows 11 recorded wave files
notes.content: A fix for morphing wave files that were recorded with Windows 11 Sound Recorder.  A fix for a rare internal file playback problem and misc. minor updates.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: Misc. fixes for long background sounds.

notes.title: Higher Quality Virtual Driver
notes.content: The MorphVOX microphone now supports 48khz/32 bit high quality audio streaming.  Audio processing quality has also been improved along with many minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: Support for single SHIFT and CONTROL key in Push-to-talk.  Fix Push-to-talk menu item.  Fix for crashing when adding some images to user added custom voices and sound effects.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: Some display tweaks in multiple languages.  Fix crashing bug when assigning images within plugins.

notes.title: Minor updates
notes.content:
Fix for Steam purchased DLC's not loading
Windows 7 compatibility fixes in Chinese

notes.title: Version 5.0.20 Update
notes.content: 24 bit support, Misc. UI tweaks and bug fixes for Quick keys.
